title: RFC: widgets always translucent on adaptive panels
line: On panels with adaptive opacity, the launcher and other widget popups now stay translucent with blur even when a maximized window makes the panel opaque.
explanation: When an adaptive panel touched a window it turned opaque and also set the containment's PrefersOpaqueBackground hint, which every applet popup (Kickoff, system tray, kicker submenus, alternatives) uses to switch to a solid background. With a maximized window that is most of the time, so popups almost never showed blur. The hint is now only set when the panel itself is set to Opaque; the panel background still turns opaque as before.

commits.message:
panel: keep applet popups translucent on adaptive panels

Adaptive panels turned opaque when touching a window and also told their
applets to use solid popups, so menus and widgets lost their blur most
of the time. Only panels set to opaque now ask for solid applet popups.

BUG: 522571

patches.diff:
From b263513e1ae7b00251aadb3b7809d1b28c5879c3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 19:44:04 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] panel: keep applet popups translucent on adaptive panels

Adaptive panels turned opaque when touching a window and also told their
applets to use solid popups, so menus and widgets lost their blur most
of the time. Only panels set to opaque now ask for solid applet popups.

BUG: 522571
---
 desktoppackage/contents/views/Panel.qml | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/views/Panel.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/views/Panel.qml
index aea1844c5b..6148885035 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/views/Panel.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/views/Panel.qml
@@ -194,7 +194,7 @@ Item {
         let floatingApplets = false
         if ((!floating || touchingWindowOrKeyboard) && (isOpaque || (touchingWindowOrKeyboard && isAdaptive))) {
             panelOpacity = 1
-            opaqueApplets = true
+            opaqueApplets = isOpaque
             floatingnessTarget = 0
             floatingApplets = (panel.floatingApplets && !floating)
         } else if ((!floating || touchingWindowOrKeyboard) && (isTransparent || (!touchingWindowOrKeyboard && isAdaptive))) {
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Adaptive panel, maximized dark Konsole: the launcher popup is solid
Same setup: the popup is translucent with blur and stays readable
Maximized Dolphin (white): weather popup from the tray is solid
Same: the popup is translucent with blur (subtle over white, readable)

review.text: Clean one-line change in `Panel.qml` that aligns `ContainmentPrefersOpaqueBackground` strictly with panels explicitly set to Opaque, keeping applet popups translucent and blurred on adaptive panels even when a maximized window turns the panel itself opaque. It matches the reporter's proposal and Nate's review guidance, and the before/after screenshots confirm good readability over both dark and light maximized windows.
